description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Apply for Standard Financial Statement Certificate. IRREVERSIBLE: this files an application with the NTS and a receipt record (cvaId + rcatNo) is created; there is no cancel action. Call without confirm first to get a preview, show it to the user, then retry with confirm=true. Never set confirm=true on your own. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

amtOpYn.description: 금액 표시 여부(Y/N, 그 항목이 있는 서식에서만 반영) (서식의 선택 입력)

bsyrEndYm.description: 사업연도 종료연월(법인, YYYYMM) (구분에 따라 서식이 요구하는 값)

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and receiving their explicit approval. Omit it on the first call to obtain the preview.

qrtTrt.description: 개인/법인 구분 코드(02 개인, 03 법인) (서식이 요구하는 값)

resnoOpYn.description: 주민등록번호 표시 여부(Y/N, 법인은 N 고정) (서식의 선택 입력)

txyr.description: 과세년도(개인, YYYY) (구분에 따라 서식이 요구하는 값)

name: hometax__certificate__apply__financial_statement
